# SEO-499: Point each feed entry at its canonical page address

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `feeds` |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

An entry's link resolves to the canonical address of the page it describes, on the production host, without a redirect and without tracking parameters appended.

## Rationale

Readers and aggregators treat the entry link as the identity of the item, so a link carrying campaign parameters or pointing at a redirect propagates a non-canonical address everywhere the entry travels.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_feeds"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Build the entry link from the same canonical value the page emits rather than from the routing table, and drop any parameter the analytics layer would otherwise append.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request every entry link in the feed and compare the final address and status against the canonical value declared by the page it reaches.
- Evidence: `FEED`, `REDIRECT_CHAIN`, `RENDERED_HTML`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_NEWS`, `AI_ASSISTANT_RETRIEVAL`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
